570: Great news: we’re making the app even more accessible! Starting today, we’ll be unlocking more Premium features for everyone. We’re kicking things off with relaxing sounds: the sleep timer is now free forever!
574: Introducing a new section in Exercises — Breathing Practices! 🧘‍♂️ They’ll help you relieve stress, manage panic, or even boost your energy! ⚡️
587: A massive update for your AI assistant! Now, Analysis is just the beginning. We’ve added full interactive dialogue: you can now discuss your insights and work through exercises under the gentle guidance of your AI assistant. And this is just the first step toward a whole new level of support!
593: Keeping your automatic thought journal now feels more like a session with a psychologist. With “Gentle Dialogue,” you can simply describe what happened in your own words — the assistant will softly guide you and fill in the necessary steps of the journal itself. This lets you focus on your memories, thoughts, and feelings in the moment, without getting distracted by the journal’s structure.
1300: Adding emotions, coping cards, and PIN codes is now free for everyone — you no longer need a subscription for them.
We’ve updated the design: a new “back” chevron on all screens, fresh headers for sections and the sleep sounds screen, and new colors for stories and the player.
Fixed white flashes when transitioning in dark mode; canceling auto-renewal no longer removes access before the end of your paid period.
